title: Decode: DSA attention path (q path, sparse MLA, DCP value, indexer)
shape: D3-32 r24: 96 requests / DP rank (384 verify rows), L~135K, k=3 (per GPU: 24 of 96 heads, DCP4 KV shard)
basis: MEASURED in-step gap512 EP16 D3 B80/B92cap profiles (perf-model/microbench/results/gap512/parsed); D3-32 r24 transfer
gap_analysis: Per DSA layer at B92 (368 rows, gap512 in-step): MlaQuery 89 us (side stream, forked against the indexer chain), QueryWait 46 us (polls other ranks' publishes), trtllm-gen sparse MLA 32 us + LSE 1.3 us, DcpValue 25 us, paged_mqa_logits 35 us, DsaIndex 8.5 us; the indexer wq_b split-K GEMM on the main stream runs 62 us while MlaQuery holds the SMs (model ach ~4 us). Model ach per layer at r24: q path (qb_wq+w_uk) ~5 us + P6 q publish ~17 us, sparse_mla ~9.6 us, P7b+w_uv ~13 us, idx_score ~18 us. MlaQuery tiles 64 rows x 24 heads into 8-CTA per-head clusters (1152 CTAs at 368 rows, ~6.5 cluster rounds) and keeps the GB300 schedule for DSA (Rubin staging disabled): HYPOTHESIS that its time is cluster-round latency, not bytes or FLOPs (measuring standalone now).
inefficiencies: MlaQuery: per-head 8-CTA cluster tiling, ~6.5 rounds at 368 rows, 89 us vs ~5 us of GEMM work (hypothesis: round latency; standalone bench running)
P6 q publish: 24 heads x 576 B x R rows multicast to 3 peers (~16 MB/layer at r24) + QueryWait cross-rank poll on the critical path
Sparse MLA trtllm-gen: 96->128 head padding (+33% MMA), per-row 2048-row KV gather (no sharing across a request's 4 verify rows), 32 us vs ~10 model
DcpValue proj: 25 us vs ~9 model (P7b push + W_UV + LSE merge)
Indexer logits: each of a request's 4 verify rows re-streams the keys (35-46 us vs 18 model)
rubin_features: tcgen05 UMMA (FP8 / block-scaled MXFP4) with TMEM accumulators
TMA gather4 for paged KV / index-key row gathers
NVLink multicast only where a push beats local recompute
plan: 1. Measure standalone (1 GPU, deployed rows 128/256/384/512): MlaQuery vs cuBLAS q_b GEMM + W_UK bmm for 24 and all 96 heads

2. q path redesign: each rank already holds every gathered row's q_a, so compute all 96 heads' FP8 query locally (gathered W_qb / W_UK at build) and drop the P6 publish + QueryWait poll; KV insert of owned slots stays
3. Sparse MLA: native 96-head FP8 decode sharing each request's gathered KV across its 4 verify rows (ncu the trtllm-gen kernel first)
4. DcpValue: re-measure after 2-3; fuse W_UV + push
6. Unit tests vs stock + microbench vs model at r1/r8/r24, step A/B on INFRA harness
